cases.name: batch-repo back: the same plan line written on both sides keeps the checkout's file and the batch's copy under run/; prune brings back a carry a stopped run left, then removes the registry; refused without a carry, usage error exits 2
cases.cmd: R={{FIX}}/brb-{{SID}}; O=$R.other; rm -rf $R $O; mkdir -p $R/todo/p $O/.claude && cd $O && git init -q && printf '{}' > .claude/kit.config.json && cd $R && git init -q && git checkout -q -b feat/x && printf '# P\nF1 todo\n' > todo/p/P-PLAN.md && export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R && B(){ python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/batch-repo.py "$@"; } && B carry F1 --repo $O --plan todo/p/P-PLAN.md >/dev/null && sed -i 's/F1 todo/F1 DONE/' $O/todo/p/P-PLAN.md && sed -i 's/F1 todo/F1 other/' todo/p/P-PLAN.md && a=$(B back F1 --repo $O | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(','.join(d['conflict']), d['kept'][0].endswith('todo/p/run/F1-carried-P-PLAN.md'))") && b="$(tail -1 todo/p/P-PLAN.md)|$(tail -1 todo/p/run/F1-carried-P-PLAN.md)" && B carry F2 --repo $O --plan todo/p/P-PLAN.md >/dev/null && sed -i 's/F1 other/F1 back/' $O/todo/p/P-PLAN.md && c=$(B prune | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin)['pruned']; print(d[0]['batch'], ','.join(d[0]['back']))") && { B back F9 --repo $O > $R.out; x=$?; e="$(grep -o 'no carry of F9' $R.out) exit=$x"; } && { B 2>/dev/null; u=$?; } ; echo "$a|$b|$c|$(tail -1 todo/p/P-PLAN.md)|$(ls .git/cctoolkit-linked-repos 2>/dev/null | wc -l)|$e|exit=$u"

expect.stdout: P-PLAN.md True|F1 other|F1 DONE|F2 P-PLAN.md|F1 back|0|no carry of F9 exit=1|exit=2

cases.name: batch-repo branch: the checkout on its default branch (main) or a detached HEAD is refused; on feat/x, --check names the switch without making it; carry creates feat/x from the repo's HEAD and says so; a repo whose local changes block the switch is refused and stays where it was; clean, it checks the existing branch out, then keeps it; git.defaultBranches of the checkout's kit.config.json extends the refusal
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/brg-{{SID}}; O=$R.other; rm -rf $R $O; mkdir -p $R/todo/p $O/.claude && cd $O && git init -q && git config user.name eval && git config user.email eval@example.invalid && git config commit.gpgsign false && printf '{}' > .claude/kit.config.json && printf 'a
' > f.txt && git add -A && git commit -qm base && base=$(git branch --show-current) && cd $R && git init -q && git config user.name eval && git config user.email eval@example.invalid && git config commit.gpgsign false && git commit -q --allow-empty -m init && git branch -M main && printf '# P
' > todo/p/P-PLAN.md && export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R && B(){ python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/batch-repo.py "$@"; } && sw(){ python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('switched') or d.get('refused'))"; } && a=$(B branch --repo $O | grep -o 'on main, a default branch') && git checkout -q --detach && b=$(B branch --repo $O | grep -o 'detached HEAD') && git checkout -q -b feat/x && c=$(B branch --repo $O --check) && d=$(git -C $O branch --list feat/x | wc -l | tr -d ' ') && e=$(B carry F1 --repo $O --plan todo/p/P-PLAN.md | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d['branch'], d['switched'])") && f=$(git -C $O branch --show-current) && B back F1 --repo $O >/dev/null && printf 'b
' > $O/f.txt && git -C $O commit -qam b && git -C $O checkout -q $base && printf 'c
' > $O/f.txt && { B branch --repo $O > $R.out; x=$?; h="$(grep -o 'cannot switch to feat/x' $R.out) exit=$x"; } && i=$([ "$(git -C $O branch --show-current)" = "$base" ] && echo stayed) && git -C $O checkout -q -- f.txt && j=$(B branch --repo $O | sw) && k=$(B branch --repo $O | sw) && mkdir -p .claude && printf '{"git": {"defaultBranches": ["feat/x"]}}' > .claude/kit.config.json && l=$(B branch --repo $O | grep -o 'on feat/x, a default branch') && echo "$a|$b|$c|$d|$e|$f|$h|$i|$j|$k|$l"

expect.stdout: on main, a default branch|detached HEAD|{"branch": "feat/x", "switched": "created"}|0|P-PLAN.md created|feat/x|cannot switch to feat/x exit=1|stayed|checked out|kept|on feat/x, a default branch
